# BIGG DOGG — Listowel, Ontario

> BIGG DOGG is a food truck serving smash burgers, freshly battered haddock, poutine, loaded fries and street eats in Listowel, Ontario.

## Quick answers

- **Where is BIGG DOGG?** Canadian Tire parking lot, 500 Mitchell Road South, Listowel, Ontario N4W 0C8.
- **When is BIGG DOGG open?** Monday through Saturday, 11:00 AM–7:00 PM. Sunday closed. Hours may change; check Facebook or call before visiting.
- **How do I order?** Call 647-679-5006 to order ahead.
- **Does BIGG DOGG cater?** Yes. Ask about work lunches, tournaments, parties and community events by text at 647-679-5006.
- **What currency are prices in?** Canadian dollars. Prices are plus tax and may change.

## Menu

- Original Smash Burger — $9.50
- Hot Dog — $7.00
- Chilli Dog — $8.00
- Freshly Battered Haddock Fish & Chips, 6 oz / 1 pc — $11.00
- Sausages: Cajun, Polish or Oktoberfest — $8.00
- Loaded Fries — $10.50
- Loaded Nachos — $10.50
- Poutine — $10.50
- Chicken Tenders, 4 pcs — $8.00
- Battered Mushrooms — $8.00
- Onion Rings — $8.50
- Side of Gravy — $2.75
- Pop / Water — $2.00
- Make any favourite a combo with fries and a drink — +$5.00
